author: PavelMakarchuk
body:
**Verdict: PolicyEngine adjustment.**

TaxAct is right. Delaware [HB 285](https://legis.delaware.gov/BillDetail/79061) (signed 2022-01-27) amended [30 Del. C. § 1106(b)(10)](https://delcode.delaware.gov/title30/c011/sc02/index.html) to exclude "any unemployment benefits received in calendar years **2020 and 2021**, to the extent included in federal adjusted gross income," and the [2021 PIT-RES instructions](https://revenuefiles.delaware.gov/2021/PIT-RES_TY21_2021-01_Instructions.pdf) put it on Line 7 — matching the bundled return.

PE-US has no DE unemployment subtraction ([subtractions list](https://github.com/PolicyEngine/policyengine-us/blob/master/policyengine_us/parameters/gov/states/de/tax/income/subtractions/subtractions.yaml)), so the $12,240 PUI stays in DE AGI:

| | PE (current) | TaxAct |
|---|---|---|
| DE AGI | 35,032 | 22,792 |
| siitax | 1,267.40 | 608 |

Tracking: PolicyEngine/policyengine-us#9065.
